protocol: Section 11 requires continuing the SAME chains deterministically rather than restarting and selecting a favourable result. The RNG stream is a pure function of the seed, so re-running the same seeds and starts for more sweeps yields the identical chain extended; the first 50,000 sweeps are bit-identical, which the deterministic-resume test pins.
ceiling: 100,000 sweeps, adopting the section 14 ceiling. The run at the ceiling is reported regardless of outcome; no further extension was made after seeing which gates passed.

omega_diagnosis.reading: This is a proposal-scale mismatch, not a wrong target. The 6D1 corpus is 3 blocks of T=5, deliberately small so prior-QMC importance sampling stays efficient, and it barely identifies omega: the posterior sd (1.977) is essentially the prior sd (2.0). The registered scales come from Stage 6B, tuned on the 500-block corpus where the posterior is far tighter, so on this model every scalar accepts at 0.96-0.98 and mixes slowly. The omega MARGINAL is nonetheless correct: it sits 0.14 MCSE from the frozen reference.
omega_diagnosis.remedy_not_yet_applied: Section 11 permits a discarded pilot to set proposal scales, provided no frozen-reference probabilities are used, the pilot draws are discarded and the formal chains restart with the scales frozen. That pilot has NOT been run; the scales were left at their registered Stage 6B values.
